Privacy Notice and Personal Data Protection Policy

Last updated: January 2026

1. Explicit Purpose of Processing

Our explicit purpose of processing personal data is to deliver requested services, maintain customer accounts, and provide user support. We ensure that why we collect and how we use your information remains strictly aligned with these lawful purposes.

2. Categories of Personal Data Collected

The categories of data and information we collect directly include name, email address, postal address, telephone number, and transaction records. We do not collect unnecessary sensitive data.

3. Data Retention Period

Our defined retention period specifies that customer records are retained for five years following account closure in compliance with established record-keeping obligations. We do not keep information longer than necessary.

4. Third-Party Sharing and Cross-Border Transfers

We work with trusted third party service providers for payment processing and cloud hosting. Some data transfer and processing occurs on cloud servers outside Sri Lanka with cross-border transfer agreements and adequate technical safeguards in place.

5. Data Subject Rights

Under data protection laws, individuals enjoy the following rights:

  • Right of Access: You may request access and obtain a copy of your data held by us.
  • Right to Rectification: You may request correction and update your details if any record is inaccurate.
  • Right to Erasure: You have the right to request deletion and erasure of your personal data when grounds apply.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw consent or opt-out at any time.
  • Right to Object: You possess the right to object to processing for direct marketing.

To exercise your rights, please submit a request by contacting our team.

6. Data Protection Officer and Privacy Contact

For any queries or grievances, you may contact our designated Data Protection Officer at dpo@lankasecure.lk or write to our privacy officer team.
